snippet.title: Cards Of The Abyss – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759650/Cards_of_the_Abyss

Cards of the Abyss is a movement based roguelike deckbuilder between Slay the Spire and Dofus. Move on a grid, dodge enemy attacks, and unleash explosive card combos to explore the Abyss and uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/QkQZr26ZGx
